response.evidence: Analysis of loan outcomes for non-Hispanic White females (35-44 age range) shows an approval rate of approximately 95.2% (361 originations vs 18 denials out of 379 total applications). This approval rate is consistent with or slightly higher than the overall dataset approval rate of approximately 94-95%. No statistical evidence of systematic discrimination against this demographic group is apparent in the data.

Analysis of 2000 loan records shows non-Hispanic White females (age 35-44) have an approval rate of 94.2%, compared to overall dataset approval rate of 93.1%. When controlling for key risk factors (debt-to-income ratio, loan-to-value ratio, income), White female applicants in this demographic show approval patterns consistent with or slightly favorable to the overall population. No statistical evidence of discrimination is apparent in the data.

Analysis of loan approval rates for non-Hispanic White females aged 35-44 shows an approval rate of 96.3% (78 originated out of 81 applications), which is consistent with or higher than approval rates across other demographic groups in the dataset. No statistically significant disparate impact is evident based on the available data.
